caseStudies.title: FB Dubai — Finance BI Dashboard
caseStudies.problem: Financial reports needed to match client requirements exactly, but KPI definitions had drifted from source data and discrepancies were flagged during UAT. Finance stakeholders also depended on ad-hoc requests instead of self-service access. TODO(Abdul): verify phrasing.
caseStudies.approach: Developed and customized financial reports per client requirements, optimized DAX and data models, and corrected KPI definitions to eliminate discrepancies flagged during UAT. Implemented dynamic slicers and parameter-driven visuals so finance stakeholders could filter reports themselves.
caseStudies.impact: Eliminated discrepancies flagged during UAT and reduced ad-hoc report requests by enabling self-service filtering for finance stakeholders.

howBuilt.schemaLabel: TODO(Abdul): verify phrasing — refined the semantic model and relationships so corrected KPI definitions aggregated correctly against source data.
howBuilt.dax:
Total Revenue =
    CALCULATE(
        SUM('GL Transactions'[Amount]),
        'Account'[Type] = "Revenue"
    )

Days Sales Outstanding =
    DIVIDE(
        SUM('GL Transactions'[AR Balance]),
        [Total Revenue] / 360
    )
howBuilt.drillThrough: TODO(Abdul): supply real/sanitized DAX measures. Drill-through pages were developed in Direct Lake mode for granular transaction-level insights.

caseStudies.title: Retail Analytics Dashboard
caseStudies.problem: Pre-built retail reports carried inconsistent measures and relationships, so sales and inventory figures did not line up with the data validated in SSMS. TODO(Abdul): verify phrasing.
caseStudies.approach: Refined the pre-built reports by restructuring measures, calculated columns, and star-schema relationships. Validated SSMS data against Power BI outputs, and performed end-to-end data quality checks on retail sales and inventory datasets.
caseStudies.impact: Identified and resolved calculation inconsistencies before production deployment, ensuring full data integrity across retail reports.

howBuilt.schemaLabel: TODO(Abdul): verify phrasing — restructured measures, calculated columns, and star-schema relationships so Power BI outputs matched SSMS data exactly.
howBuilt.dax:
Gross Margin % =
    DIVIDE(
        [Sales] - [COGS],
        [Sales]
    )

Inventory Turnover =
    DIVIDE(
        [COGS],
        AVERAGE('Inventory Snapshot'[Stock Value])
    )

caseStudies.title: FB IT — IT Operations Dashboard
caseStudies.problem: The IT operations semantic model had Galaxy model filter-direction and relationship issues across 10+ tables, causing cross-filter conflicts that broke accurate data aggregation.
caseStudies.approach: Fixed the Galaxy model's relationship and filter-direction issues across 10+ tables and developed drill-through pages in Direct Lake mode for granular transaction-level insights.
caseStudies.impact: Restored accurate data aggregation, with directional data flow validated end-to-end against source definitions.
